title: Senior Payroll and Benefits Analyst
text: Job Application for Senior Payroll and Benefits Analyst at OpenAI Apply Now Senior Payroll and Benefits Analyst at OpenAI (View all jobs) San Francisco, California, United States Overview OpenAI Finance ensures the organization is set up for success in pursuit of its mission. This role is an exciting position that demands excellence in execution, attention to detail, and a proven track record of maintaining the highest level of confidentiality. As a Payroll and Benefits Specialist you will contribute to the growth and success of the Finance and HR Departments. You will be responsible for managing our end-to-end payroll and benefits operations, working closely with Accounting and HR. This position can be based in our San Francisco headquarters, or remote within US (with special conditions for Colorado). In this role you will: Manage regular, multi-state payroll process for all non-exempt US employees, ensuring all forms of compensation are properly reconciled and paid timely Partner with HR to ensure accurate processing of new hires, terminations, raises, bonuses, leaves of absence, and other personnel events Provide first level support to employees with payroll related questions relating to calculation of wages, deductions (including taxes and benefit premiums), PTO, and other related payroll inquiries Manage end-to-end payroll and benefits activities including, but not limited to, maintaining records, filing tax reports, completing quarter- and year-end procedures, assisting with audits, and verifying the integrity of personnel data throughout our tech stack Participate in the monthly accounting close process including preparing journal entries, performing reconciliations, and providing ad hoc request support pertaining to your areas of ownership Maintain the highest level of confidentiality for all employee payroll and personnel records Manage payroll compliance with regulatory agencies, including filing registrations in new jurisdictions and liaising with local authorities It will be great if you have: 5+ years of relevant experience at a high growth start-up and/or public company Strong organization skills, ability to set priorities and meet deadlines Comfortable with Excel and other Microsoft office applications Strong knowledge of federal, state, and local regulations pertaining to payroll Experience with BambooHR, TRAX, Workday, and NetSuite a plus Effective oral and written communication skills, especially working directly with employees About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology. title: Account Executive
text: Job Application for Account Executive at OpenAI Apply Now Account Executive at OpenAI (View all jobs) United States The Financial Times wrote that “OpenAI ranks as one of the most unusual organizations on the planet”. We’re one of the leaders in AI development and we’re working to build safe Artificial General Intelligence (AGI). We believe AGI has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges such as climate change, affordable healthcare, and personalized education, and we want the economic upside of AGI to be widely shared. About the Product We’re building the definitive platform for AI technology, making it easier for developers to benefit from AI. Last year we introduced the OpenAI API which makes leading AI technology available to developers via a simple HTTPS call. GPT3 was the first AI technology available via the API, allowing developers to integrate any language task into their product. The MIT Technology Review listed GPT3 as one of the 10 Breakthrough Technologies of 2021 (alongside mRNA vaccines!). Recently, we introduced Codex into the API, a new product that translates natural language to code. Instragram’s co-founder called Github Copilot , an early product powered by Codex, “the single most mind-blowing application of ML I’ve ever seen”. We’re working to bring other research efforts into the API, such as Dall-E, AI which generates images from text and CLIP, a state-of-the-art image classification AI . About the role This is an exciting time at OpenAI! In the last three months, we launched two groundbreaking products Codex and Copilot , and established our go-to-market team to ramp up our commercialization efforts. As an early member of our sales team, you'll help companies big (Fortune 100) and small (startups) embrace groundbreaking technology to radically improve their businesses. You’ll also define the vision and strategy of our Go-To-Market motion, and drive the growth and expansion of our customer base. By being curious, determined, and kind you’ll help an exceptionally talented and collegial team sell products that change the world. text: Job Application for Software Engineer, Internal Platforms at OpenAI Apply Now Software Engineer, Internal Platforms at OpenAI (View all jobs) San Francisco, CA OpenAI is seeking a core (“full-stack”) software developer to help us build a suite of cutting-edge products, research tools, and infrastructure. We are looking for a self-starter engineer who loves building and deploying production-tier systems in an iterative and agile environment. In this role, you will design, develop and maintain the tools & infrastructure required for a variety of research and consumer projects. A deep understanding of machine learning is not required, but a general interest is recommended, as you will be interfacing with many such technologies. We value the ability to swiftly obtain a deep technical understanding of new domains, and to self-direct and identify the most important problems to solve. OpenAI utilizes dozens of languages, libraries, and platforms, but an expert grasp of Python is the only concrete technical requirement. The primary, initial project is a web application involving Python (Flask) and Javascript (React). Previous experience with these two frameworks is strongly preferred. Other recommended knowledge includes Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, and API patterns, as well as an understanding of many of the aspects of web application development (security, reliability, scalability, maintainability, etc.). We’re exploring many exciting new directions at OpenAI and would be thrilled for you to join our effort! title: Research Scientist, AI Futures
text: Job Application for Research Scientist, AI Futures at OpenAI Apply Now Research Scientist, AI Futures at OpenAI (View all jobs) San Francisco, California, United States About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core. OpenAI is dedicated to putting that alignment of interests first — ahead of profit. To achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. Our investment in diversity, equity, and inclusion is ongoing, executed through a wide range of initiatives, and championed and supported by leadership. At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology. About the team The Futures team, part of OpenAI’s Policy Research team, is responsible for long-term forecasting and planning for advanced AI. We conduct interdisciplinary research on how AI development might change the world, and what outcomes we should aim towards. About the role As a Research Scientist on the Futures team at OpenAI, you’ll help us steer AI development and deployment in beneficial directions. We are looking for researchers who are excited about understanding how AI might have a large-scale impact on the world, and what OpenAI can do to have a positive influence. Your work will involve analysing the impacts of AI and possible interventions for governing them, using knowledge and perspectives from social sciences and the humanities. Since we're a small team, we expect that you'll significantly shape our research directions and methodologies. You'll have the latitude to collaborate with relevant external scholars, and scope to develop your own research agenda over time. The ideal candidate will be self-directed and will enjoy asking foundational research questions, challenging (and improving) existing frameworks for thinking about AI, and engaging broad audiences with their research. We're particularly looking for candidates who are open to pursuing unusually exploratory and open-ended research. Example research questions might include: How might we understand, measure, and anticipate the capabilities of AI systems, and the effects they have on the world? How will ongoing cultural and economic changes interact with AI development? What implicit assumptions are shaping the ways that people think about AI development? How can we best inform and prepare the world for advanced AI capabilities, and possible risks? What are the best ways to distribute benefits from AI worldwide, and to future generations? title: Customer Solutions Engineer
text: Job Application for Customer Solutions Engineer at OpenAI Apply Now Customer Solutions Engineer at OpenAI (View all jobs) San Francisco, California, United States OpenAI is one of the leaders in AI research and deployment, and we're working to build safe Artificial General Intelligence (AGI). We believe AGI has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges such as climate change, affordable healthcare, and personalized education, and we want the economic upside of AGI to be widely shared. About our product We're building the definitive platform for AI technology, making it easier for developers to benefit from AI via a simple HTTPS call. We accomplished this by launching the OpenAI API to the public in 2021. We think the best way to see the potential and magic of our product is to try it yourself. You can create a free account and try our API here . GPT-3 was the first AI technology available via the API, allowing developers to integrate any language task into their product. The MIT Technology Review listed GPT-3 as one of the 10 Breakthrough Technologies of 2021 (alongside other innovations like mRNA vaccines). Recently, we introduced Codex into our API, a new product that translates natural language to code. Instagram's co-founder called Github Copilot (an early product powered by Codex) "the single most mind-blowing application of ML I've ever seen." We're working to bring other research efforts into the API, such as DALL-E 2 , which generates images from text, and CLIP , a state-of-the-art image classification AI. About the role Our Go-to-Market team is responsible for empowering developers and enterprises to build and scale production applications with the OpenAI API, guiding and supporting customers to attain maximum benefits from deploying our highly-capable models. OpenAI's customers represent a range of diverse backgrounds and maturity, from early-stage seed ideas to established global enterprises. We are looking for an engineer who wants to take the world's most capable AI systems and help customers solve previously unsolvable problems. You'll be a crucial member of our Go-to-Market organization as the first Solutions Engineer, tasked with building software and rapidly building prototypes that delight our customers and, in return, their customers. You will collaborate and work with some of the world's best machine learning researchers and engineers in a low ego, high-impact environment. In this role, you will: Build custom product demos that highlight the utility of our APIs. Build custom integrations with our APIs and guide customers on their journey to production. Answer technical questions from customers about our APIs' operation, integration, and use. Highlight new and creative ways customers can integrate with our APIs. Serve as the connective tissue between our Product Engineers, Research Engineers, and the customer. Use your expertise in programming with Javascript and Python. You might thrive in this role if you: Have at least three years of professional software or solution engineering experience. Have a track record of rapidly prototyping ideas of your own volition and seeing them through to reality. Can identify technical pain points in our and customer systems and can lead others to appropriate corrective action. Have a desire to work directly with technical and non-technical customers, be a good listener and interpreter of their needs, and not be afraid to inquire deeper. Have a humble attitude, an eagerness to help others, and a desire to do whatever it takes to make both your team and our customers succeed. Own problems end-to-end and are willing to pick up whatever knowledge you're missing to get the job done. Build tools to accelerate and operationalize your workflows, but only when off-the-shelf solutions would not do. Adept at context switching and working on multiple projects at once, ruthlessly prioritizing and finding efficiency gains. title: Software Engineer, Large-Scale Machine Learning
text: Job Application for Software Engineer, Large-Scale Machine Learning at OpenAI Apply Now Software Engineer, Large-Scale Machine Learning at OpenAI (View all jobs) San Francisco, CA Our mission at OpenAI is to discover and enact the path to safe, beneficial AGI. To do this, we believe that many technical breakthroughs are needed in generative modeling, reinforcement learning, large scale optimization, active learning, among other topics. We’re looking for software engineers to help us build models vastly more capable than GPT-3, CLIP, and DALL-E. We train our models on some of the largest machine learning supercomputers in the world, which requires a team with deep software engineering expertise in order to extract maximum performance. The challenges we face are difficult, but are similar in shape to those you’d see at a growing web startup. We’re constantly improving the instropectability and reliability of our systems, finding new performance bottlenecks, and designing better abstractions for managing our code. We sweat the details, making sure we understand every piece of our system, but are also pragmatic — we’ll sometimes pause further progress to perfect our tooling to understand a new issue, and sometimes we’ll just ignore weirdness or instabilities in order to continue training our models. Our stack is primarily Python + Kubernetes. No machine learning experience is required — we can teach you whatever ML you need — but we look for depth of software and infrastructure experience. This role is not a support role; you’ll be expected to be self-directed and find the most important problems to solve while working in close concert with a team with a shared goal. We look for a track record of the following: Experience designing, implementing, and running production services, especially through a growth phase or period of rapid change. Designing clean and flexible abstractions for new problems which are still in the process of being understood. A desire to dig into problems across the stack, whether networking issues, performance problems, memory leaks, or simply reading unfamiliar code to find where issues might lie. Comfort managing and monitoring infrastructure deployments. You might be a good fit if you: Are self-directed and enjoy figuring out the most important problem to work on. Own problems end-to-end, and are willing to pick up whatever knowledge you're missing to get the job done. Have brought software from an early- to mid-stage, such as being an early infrastructure engineer or founder at a startup, or created a new infrastructure component at a large company. Find or create the best tools to accelerate your and others’ workflows, and are very efficient in your editor and shell. Enjoy working as part of a fast-moving team, where perfectionism can sometimes be at odds with (but sometimes directly required for) pragmatism. title: Research Engineer, Safety
text: Job Application for Research Engineer, Safety at OpenAI Apply Now Research Engineer, Safety at OpenAI (View all jobs) San Francisco, CA Our mission at OpenAI is to discover and enact the path to safe, beneficial AGI. To do this, we believe that many technical breakthroughs are needed in generative modeling, reinforcement learning, large scale optimization, active learning, among other topics. The Applied Safety team is building safety specifications, processes, and measurement tools for general-purpose AI. We’re looking for safety-focused research engineers to work on measurement tools with us: we aim to develop a world-class toolkit for measuring the safety-relevant characteristics of our datasets, models, and algorithms. This is high-impact work that will help teams across OpenAI meet safety goals. This is not about safety for narrow AI systems like autonomous vehicles: this is about safety for general-purpose AI systems that have large, uncharted surface areas of potential risk. Given that the field is quite young, your work may be foundational for future standards and professional duties. In this role, you will: Take ambiguous, open-ended problems in measuring safety for general-purpose AI, make them tractable and well-posed, and build the solutions. Write clean, performant code for tools you build, with a focus on making them usable for researchers and engineers across the company. Engage with literature and experts across many different research domains (social sciences, physical sciences, economics, politics, etc.) to reason about impact from or interactions with general-purpose AI. Figure out how to measure safety concerns relevant for those domains. Build tools that help us proactively prevent a wide range of potential AI safety issues from the mundane to the speculative. Develop with a focus on scale and data. For example, if you want to measure whether a model has a certain qualitative behavior, you may need to build a dataset of hundreds or thousands of examples of that behavior to check against. Contribute to building a safety culture at OpenAI by shipping safety tools internally and helping everyone make the most use of them. This role might be a good fit for you if you: Have strong programming skills. Are a fast learner who can quickly spin up on risks and impacts from bleeding-edge tech that will profoundly change the world in the near future. Are sincerely interested in reducing harms from AI. Nice to haves: Experience working on large-scale natural language datasets or image datasets. Experience building and productionizing classifiers. Research experience in ML / AI. title: Senior Software Engineer, Platform
text: Job Application for Senior Software Engineer, Platform at OpenAI Apply Now Senior Software Engineer, Platform at OpenAI (View all jobs) San Francisco, CA Our mission at OpenAI is to discover and enact the path to safe, beneficial AGI. To do this, we believe that many technical breakthroughs are needed in generative modeling, reinforcement learning, large scale optimization, active learning, among other topics. Join the API team , a core group who work to bring OpenAI's technology to the world in partnership with other organizations. We are looking for a self-starter engineer who loves building and running production systems. In this role, you will build the systems that power a breadth of production ML use cases. You’ll also work closely with and directly accelerate machine learning researchers, but don't need to be a machine learning expert yourself. We value people who can quickly obtain a deep technical understanding of new domains, and enjoy being self-directed and identifying the most important problems to solve. On this team you will be expected to balance building new components while improving the foundation on which it all runs. The codebase is currently a mix of Go and Python. Our services run on multiple Kubernetes clusters, and the clusters are versioned in Terraform. We always aim to deploy reliable systems with low error rates and redundancy built in. We’re only getting started building the API, and would like you to join to help build the rest of it! We look for a track record of the following: Experience designing, implementing, and running production services. Comfort managing and monitoring infrastructure deployments. Willingness to debug problems across the stack, such as networking issues, performance problems, or memory leaks. Experience with high-performance computing or infrastructure orchestration tools are a bonus. While we don't require machine learning expertise, it's a bonus to find someone with experience in tools of high performance computing, machine learning optimizations, and model scaling. This could include experience with mpi, NCCL, CUDA kernels, model and parameter sharding, Infiniband, and GPU hardware. Ultimately it is more important one has a willingness to explore, understand systems, and learn how it all ties together. We are constantly discovering new capabilities in our models. Turning those discoveries into safe and performant production systems requires a generalist mindset and curiosity. You might be a good match if you: Are self-directed and enjoy figuring out the most important problem to work on. Own problems end-to-end, and are willing to pick up whatever knowledge you're missing to get the job done. Know your way around a Unix shell. Build tools to accelerate your own workflows, but only when off-the-shelf solutions would not do. Have been a startup founder or an early-stage engineer. Enjoy fast paced work environment with tight feedback loops. About OpenAI We’re building safe Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), and ensuring it leads to a good outcome for humans. title: Research Scientist, Geopolitics of AI
text: Job Application for Research Scientist, Geopolitics of AI at OpenAI Apply Now Research Scientist, Geopolitics of AI at OpenAI (View all jobs) San Francisco, CA Our mission at OpenAI is to discover and enact the path to safe, beneficial AGI. To do this, we believe that many technical breakthroughs are needed in generative modeling, reinforcement learning, large scale optimization, active learning, among other topics. While we are a US-based organization, this mission transcends borders. Our ability to deeply understand the geopolitical consequences of our decisions and of AI more broadly is key to achieving this mission. As a Research Scientist on the Policy Research team at OpenAI, you’ll contribute directly to short-term and long-term analyses that inform OpenAI’s strategies as we pursue responsible research and deployment of our AI systems. We are looking for a researcher who is excited to collaborate across the technical and policy teams in the organization. The role will involve conducting research of immediate relevance to OpenAI decision-making but a researcher in this role will also have a broad remit to conduct and publish research following their own agenda, and latitude to collaborate with relevant external scholars. The ideal candidate will be self-directed, thrive in fast-paced environments, and bring deep understanding and experience in geopolitics and some level of technical understanding of AI (or an interest in skilling up). Example research questions might include: How can we best inform and prepare the world for advanced AI capabilities? What are the best ways to distribute benefits from AI to different regions around the world? How might different geopolitical actors anticipate and react to our developments? How should we think about how our actions today affect the geopolitics of the future, and any path dependencies? Representative responsibilities: Own and pursue a research agenda aimed resolving uncertainties in the geopolitical dimensions of AI progress. Understand and clearly communicate geopolitical considerations to decision-makers at OpenAI. Advise our technical and applied teams on decisions with relevant geopolitical dimensions. We're seeking someone with: A PhD or equivalent level of research experience in a relevant area (political science, economics, security studies, international relations), or relevant research experience and an established research track record, demonstrated by journal publications and/or conference papers. text: Job Application for Technical Program Manager - Data Labeling and Human Feedback at OpenAI Apply Now Technical Program Manager - Data Labeling and Human Feedback at OpenAI (View all jobs) San Francisco, California, United States About the Team The goal of the Applied AI team is to turn OpenAI’s technology into useful products. We see this as a path towards safe and broadly beneficial AGI, by gaining practical experience in deploying these technologies safely and making them easy to build with. In summer 2020, we introduced GPT-3 as the first product on the OpenAI API, allowing developers to integrate its ability to understand and generate natural language into their product. The MIT Technology Review listed GPT-3 as one of its 10 Breakthrough Technologies of the past year (alongside mRNA vaccines!). Recently, we introduced Codex , a new product that can translate natural language to code. Instagram’s co-founder called Github Copilot , an early product powered by Codex, “the single most mind-blowing application of ML I’ve ever seen.” About the Role Our ability to train increasingly more capable and safer models depends on collecting high-quality labelled data. These data collection efforts also power our API’s anti-abuse and safety filters. We are looking for a Technical Project Manager to drive strategic and operational initiatives to help the Applied AI team unlock as much value and insight as possible from labelled data. The right individual will ensure high-quality execution of the labelling pipeline. This includes partnering with researchers and product managers to design labelling tasks that support the team’s objective, owning relationships with and project managing our labelling vendors, and developing workflows and quality metrics. In this role, you will: Work with product, research, and engineering teams to design labelling tasks that help us achieve our product goals. Own quality assurance for data-labelling, including surfacing edge-cases and ensuring the downstream usability of the data for technical teams. Own relationships with external partners and service providers (e.g., major labelling companies and specialized experts) to deliver excellent data-labelling quality. In partnership with technical teams, develop a comprehensive set of metrics that accurately measures the quality of human feedback and optimizes performance. Develop project plans that account for timelines, budgets, project goals, and other key priorities and constraints. Project manage the delivery of particular data-labelling workflows to ensure technical needs are met. In partnership with technical teams, determine and oversee appropriate processes for refreshing labels and assessing model drift throughout the labeled-data lifecycle. Work cross-functionally with research, engineering, policy, HR, finance, legal, security (and more!) to ensure we’re thoughtfully balancing technical and organizational needs. You might thrive in this role if you have: Experience developing tasks workflows and defining quality metrics for an outsourced or contract labor force. Experience partnering with highly technical teams, ideally at technology or related companies. Experience managing external partners and contracted workforces in a technical field. title: Software Engineer, Security
text: Job Application for Software Engineer, Security at OpenAI Apply Now Software Engineer, Security at OpenAI (View all jobs) San Francisco, California, United States OpenAI is pushing artificial intelligence to unprecedented scale. We have a large cloud footprint and run some of the biggest Kubernetes clusters in the world. As our scale has grown, so has the surface area we need to protect. While advanced AI can benefit the world, in the wrong hands, it can also be used maliciously. Your job will be to protect our work from those who seek to misuse it. As a Security Engineer, you will help scale the security program at OpenAI. Your technical expertise is second only to your integrity and passion for security and technology. You will work alongside a diverse team of engineers, developers, and security advisers to design, architect, and drive security improvements across OpenAI. We are a small company, and intend to stay small: as an early member of the information security team, the decisions you make today will have significant impact on the organization today and into the future. We’re looking for an engineer who wishes to work on a mix of security, software, and infrastructure challenges while growing their skills in the detection and response space. You will: Empower OpenAI's AI researchers and developers to do their best work securely. Contribute to the technical architecture and implementation of OpenAI’s detection and response pipelines. Build and deploy centralized logging and alerting infrastructure to proactively identify malicious threats. Develop, measure, and tune detection rules to ensure effective and sustainable incident response. Design, architect, and implement defensive security controls across endpoints (macOS, Windows), servers (Linux), and SaaS/self-hosted applications. Collaborate with your fellow security engineers to drive improvements across identity access and management (IAM), device management, productivity software, and our use of public cloud environments (e.g. AWS, Microsoft Azure). You may be a fit for this role if you have: 3+ years of experience in security or a security-adjacent field, with an interest in becoming adept at detection and response. Experience working with security logging pipelines (e.g. Splunk, ELK, SumoLogic). Experience deploying and managing endpoint security solutions (e.g. osquery, EDR tools). Experience with public cloud providers (e.g. Amazon AWS, Microsoft Azure) and a desire to become adept at protecting Azure and our internal application infrastructure. Knowledge of modern adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures. Ability to empathize and collaborate with colleagues, independently manage and run projects, and prioritize efforts for risk reduction. text: Job Application for OpenAI Residency at OpenAI Apply Now OpenAI Residency at OpenAI (View all jobs) San Francisco, California, United States About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core. OpenAI is dedicated to putting that alignment of interests first — ahead of profit. To achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. Our investment in diversity, equity, and inclusion is ongoing, executed through a wide range of initiatives, and championed and supported by leadership. At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology. About the OpenAI Residency The OpenAI Residency provides a pathway to a full-time role at OpenAI for researchers and engineers who don't currently focus on artificial intelligence. The Residency will focus on recruiting from underrepresented groups in technology. The program is an iteration of our former Scholars and Fellows programs. The Residency shifts the focus away from curriculum-based learning, instead giving Residents an opportunity to work collaboratively alongside OpenAI teams on active projects. The first cohort of the six-month program begins in April 2022. As a Resident, you’ll be embedded within our Research & Applied AI teams working on real, cutting-edge AI problems. Residents will be compensated as fully salaried employees for the duration of the program. Over the last three years we’ve made more than 20 full-time hires through our mentorship programs, representing one in six members of our technical staff, and our new iteration will broaden the range of candidates we are considering. Excellent work and experience can come from both inside and outside of the traditional education and work settings. OpenAI has long been home to many self-taught researchers and engineers. If you have an unconventional educational background, we encourage you to apply. Our goal is for this program to be as inclusive and diverse as possible, and we will provide immigration and relocation support to high-potential talent globally. The Residency offers two distinct tracks: The AI Software Engineering track is a great match for people that have an engineering background and would like to advance to a Software Engineer position in an AI company. We are looking for candidates with engineering experience in fast-paced environments. text: Job Application for Research Scientist, Policy at OpenAI Apply Now Research Scientist, Policy at OpenAI (View all jobs) San Francisco, CA As a Research Scientist on the Policy Research team at OpenAI, you’ll contribute directly to short-term and long-term analyses that inform OpenAI’s strategies as we pursue responsible research and deployment of our AI systems. We are looking for researchers who are excited to collaborate across technical, policy, and/or product teams in the organization. The role will involve conducting research of immediate relevance to OpenAI decision-making but a researcher in this role will also have a broad remit to conduct and publish research following their own agenda, and latitude to collaborate with relevant external scholars. Members of our team come with or build up specialties in a particular area of AI safety. We are currently hiring for multiple Research Scientists, and ask you to propose an area of focus. We’re interested in everything from safety to geopolitics to HCI. The ideal candidate will be self-directed and will enjoy asking foundational research questions, creative research design, analytical problem solving, and engaging broad audiences with their research. Example research questions might include: How might we understand, measure, and anticipate potential impacts of AI systems, such as risks of producing harmful speech or environmental impacts? How do we work with different interests (e.g. labor, governments, etc.) to help bridge knowledge gaps of current and future AI development and processes? How can we best inform and prepare the world for advanced AI capabilities? What are the best ways to distribute benefits from AI to different regions around the world? How might different geopolitical actors anticipate and react to our developments? title: Software Engineer, Internal Business Tools
text: Job Application for Software Engineer, Internal Business Tools at OpenAI Apply Now Software Engineer, Internal Business Tools at OpenAI (View all jobs) San Francisco, California, United States About the team OpenAI's ambitious mission is dependent on tight collaboration between our research, engineering, and business teams. Our business teams are comprised of various functions, including Strategic/Technical Finance, HR, Recruiting, Legal, and Operations. We are always seeking ways to build and scale our processes and data across the company that allow us to make significant progress on the path to AGI. About the role In this role, you'll act as a full-stack engineer to help us develop unique, functional tools and systems that will help automate and streamline business-critical work. You'll do this by leveraging existing frameworks, infrastructure, and the OpenAI API and creating novel solutions from the ground up. Developers and customers worldwide use our API to build incredible ML-powered tools, services, and solutions that help people grow their creativity and extend their productivity. We think the best way to see the potential and magic of this is to try it yourself. You can create a free account and try our API here . As a critical member of our Business organization, you'll partner with various leaders, including our COO and VP of People. You will be a part of our Partnership Research team. In addition, you'll: Build functional tools to support various needs, such as internal chatbots, web apps, API hooks, and web scrapers. Build out integrations with systems and APIs we use across the organization. Help answer technical questions from our teams when onboarding new technology solutions. Prototype new and creative ways we can utilize our API internally. You might thrive in this role if you: Are proficient in Javascript and Python. Have deep experience working with APIs, particularly the OpenAI API. Build tools to accelerate and operationalize workflows, and know when off-the-shelf solutions will not do. Have a strong record of building custom apps or tools based on the needs of a business. Enjoy rapidly prototyping ideas of your own volition and seeing them through to reality. Own problems end-to-end and are willing to pick up whatever knowledge you're missing to get the job done. Can identify technical pain points in our systems and can lead others to appropriate corrective action Feel excited to collaborate and learn with technical and non-technical teams, including our ML and platform engineers. title: Senior Product Policy Manager
text: Job Application for Senior Product Policy Manager at OpenAI Apply Now Senior Product Policy Manager at OpenAI (View all jobs) San Francisco, California, United States About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core. OpenAI is dedicated to putting that alignment of interests first — ahead of profit. To achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. Our investment in diversity, equity, and inclusion is ongoing, executed through a wide range of initiatives, and championed and supported by leadership. At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology. About the Team The Applied AI Team’s purpose is to commercialize OpenAI’s technology in a manner that leads to broadly beneficial AGI - in particular, by gaining practical experience in deploying these technologies safely. Last year, we introduced GPT-3 as the first technology on the OpenAI API, allowing developers to integrate its ability to understand and generate natural language into their product. The MIT Technology Review listed GPT-3 as one of the 10 Breakthrough Technologies of 2021 (alongside mRNA vaccines!). Recently, we introduced Codex , a new product that can translate natural language to code. Instagram’s co-founder called Github Copilot , an early product powered by Codex, “the single most mind-blowing application of ML I’ve ever seen.” We’re also working to bring other research efforts into the API such as DALL-E , which generates images from text descriptions. The Product Safety team within Applied AI ensures that OpenAI’s AI is used responsibly en route to - and eventually as part of - beneficial AGI. Product Safety’s mission is to ensure OpenAI’s technology is not used in unsafe ways; to advance the set of use-cases that OpenAI can safely permit; and to deliver a great developer experience with respect to safety. About the Role We are looking for an experienced Product Policy leader to drive, write, and deliver various product policies for the OpenAI API. Serving these cutting-edge technologies introduces a host of challenging questions: How do we responsibly democratize access to our technology? What uses of our technology are we confident are beneficial? The right individual for this role can bring clarity to the policies we most need to enact, and can balance internal and external input in making complicated decisions. Ultimately, our product policies will be fundamental to achieving OpenAI’s mission of broad benefits from AGI. In this role, you will: Drive, write, and deliver product policies for the OpenAI API Prioritize what topics to tackle, in what order, at what level of depth Conduct research and gather external input to inform the right policy decisions Align internal stakeholders around particular policies and the overall approach Determine how to communicate policies externally, in how much detail Ensure the enforceability of policies, iterating on edge-cases as needed Measure the impact of policies, updating in response to feedback Define specific use-case policies that enhance the safety of particular uses of the OpenAI API Research and weigh the benefits of particular use-cases against their risks Determine and implement appropriate mitigations for particular use-cases (e.g., requiring chatbots to use our Content Filter) Define safety requirements to unlock further use-cases and continue improving the safety of our technology Create a suite of policies that improve the developer safety experience, while holding a high bar for safety standards Interview and survey customers to understand their outlook on safety, their interests, and their pain-points Balance a simple, streamlined developer experience with implementation of important safety policies Determine scalable approaches for ensuring safety across our tens of thousands of active developers You might thrive in this role if you: Have significant experience drafting or enforcing socially-consequential product policy decisions, especially at leading technology- or developer-focused companies, and ideally across multiple companies Have experience aligning diverse set of stakeholders on specific decisions in the product policy space Understand the operational challenges of enforcing product policies, including in the content moderation space, and can incorporate this to policy design Can analyze the benefits and risks of open-ended problem spaces, working both from first-principles and from industry best practices Are familiar with policy and safety/responsibility questions related to AI in society Note that this role involves grappling with questions of sensitive uses of OpenAI’s technology, including at times erotic, violent, or otherwise-disturbing material. At times, this role will involve engaging with such content, as may be necessary to inform our policy approaches. title: Software Engineer, ML Ops
text: Job Application for Software Engineer, ML Ops at OpenAI Apply Now Software Engineer, ML Ops at OpenAI (View all jobs) San Francisco, California, United States About the Team The Applied team safely brings OpenAI's technology to the world. We released the GPT-3 API and Codex , which powers GitHub's Copilot . There's a lot more on the immediate horizon. Our customers build fast-growing businesses around our APIs, which power product features that were never before possible. We simultaneously ensure that our powerful tools are used responsibly. Safe deployment is more important to us than unfettered growth. The Engineering team wraps a massive fleet of GPUs in scalable, robust, infrastructure powered by Kubernetes, Go, Python, Terraform, Redis, Kafka, Postgres, and Snowflake. Our APIs are powered by Python Flask and OpenAPI with a React frontend. About the Role We are looking for an engineer who wants to take the world's largest and most capable AI models and optimize them for use in a high-volume, low-latency, and high-availability production environment. In this role, you will: Optimize our code and fleet of Azure VMs to utilize every FLOP and every GB of GPU RAM of our hardware. Build tooling to give us visibility into our bottlenecks and sources of instability and then architect and implement solutions to address the highest priority issues. Introduce new techniques, tools, or architectures that improve the performance, latency, throughput, and efficiency of our models. Work alongside machine learning researchers, engineers, and product managers to bring our latest technologies into production. You might thrive in this role if you: Have at least 3 years of professional software engineering experience. Have an understanding of modern ML architectures and an intuition for where optimizations can be made. Have or can quickly gain familiarity with PyTorch, NVidia GPUs and the software stacks that optimize them (e.g. NCCL, CUDA), as well as HPC technologies such as InfiniBand, MPI, etc. Have experience architecting, observing, and debugging production distributed systems. Have a humble attitude, an eagerness to help your colleagues, and a desire to do whatever it takes to make the team succeed. Have needed to rebuild or substantially refactor production systems several times over due to rapidly increasing scale. Are self-directed and enjoy figuring out the most important problem to work on. Own problems end-to-end, and are willing to pick up whatever knowledge you're missing to get the job done. Build tools to accelerate your own workflows, but only when off-the-shelf solutions would not do. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology. title: Engineering Manager
text: Job Application for Engineering Manager at OpenAI Apply Now Engineering Manager at OpenAI (View all jobs) San Francisco, California, United States About the team We believe that increasing compute is a huge lever to AI progress. The Supercomputing team owns the entire process of building OpenAI’s compute and infrastructure, which includes 1) the sourcing of hardware and system design, 2) the deployment of huge clusters using Kubernetes and Azure, 3) operating the compute platform for running/training the world’s largest AI models. We work at the very cutting edge of speed and scale, combining Site Reliability Engineering practices with the traditions of High-Performance Computing (HPC), in a modern cloud and containerized environment. We build some of the largest Supercomputers in the world. When our Owl cluster launched it in 2019 it would've been among the top 5 of the TOP500 supercomputers in the world. Since then we've only continued to grow. See this blog post to get a sense of what kind of challenges we solve in our day-to-day work: Scaling Kubernetes to 7,500 Nodes You won’t encounter any other organization in the world with as much compute per employee. We are a small team that moves quickly, with access to huge resources, working with a direct impact on the success of OpenAI and, by extension, the field of AI as a whole. text: Job Application for Senior Software Engineer, Compilers at OpenAI Apply Now Senior Software Engineer, Compilers at OpenAI (View all jobs) San Francisco, California, United States About the team: Our Acceleration team works on everything that makes models faster and more efficient, with the goal of accelerating progress toward new AI breakthroughs. We frequently collaborate with other research teams to speed up the development of new state-of-the-art capabilities, and there are many opportunities to learn about the latest deep-learning techniques. For example, we recently collaborated with our Codegen research team on the Codex model , which can generate code in Python and over a dozen other programming languages! Creating AI which can solve hard symbolic reasoning problems is one of the most difficult problems in modern deep learning and we’re attacking it head-on. We seek new ways for increasingly powerful AI systems to interact with the world through a very general interface of computer code. Our first release, Codex , demonstrates the power of neural program synthesis through a family of large generative models that power GitHub Copilot . We’re excited to explore creative new interactions which will reshape the way the industry thinks about coding. On the Code Generation team, you’ll work at the very center of OpenAI’s mission to create artificial general intelligent AI systems that benefit all of humanity. In our day-to-day work, we build on top of all the achievements of OpenAI to date, by training some of the largest models ever trained, studying scaling laws, running distributed reinforcement learning, and aligning our most capable models. We seek a talented Research Engineer to us deliver the next breakthrough. In this role, you will: Write clean and performant code to train ML models, focusing on throughput, stability, and ML metrics Build interfaces for humans to interact with new generations of code-generating models Debug complex distributed systems Clean and analyze large datasets Implement sandboxing techniques for safe code execution This might be a good match if you: Have strong programming and problem-solving skills, with a 3+ year track record of relevant engineering experience Are a team player: we believe in working collectively towards a common goal. title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure
text: Job Application for Software Engineer, Infrastructure at OpenAI Apply Now Software Engineer, Infrastructure at OpenAI (View all jobs) San Francisco, California, United States About the Team We believe that increasing compute is a huge lever to AI progress. The Supercomputing team owns the entire process of building OpenAI’s compute and infrastructure, which includes 1) the sourcing of hardware and system design, 2) the deployment of huge clusters using Kubernetes and Azure, 3) building the internal experiment platform for running/training the world’s largest AI models. We work at the very cutting edge of speed and scale, combining the traditions of High-Performance Computing (HPC) in a modern cloud and containerized environment. We build some of the largest Supercomputers in the world. When our Owl cluster launched it in 2019 it would've been among the top 5 of the TOP500 supercomputers in the world. Since then we've only continued to grow. See this blog post to get a sense of what kind of challenges we solve in our day-to-day work: Scaling Kubernetes to 7,500 Nodes You won’t encounter any other organization in the world with as much compute per employee. We are a small team that moves quickly, with access to huge resources, working with a direct impact on the success of OpenAI and, by extension, the field of AI as a whole. About the Role In this role, you will work with a small team of software engineers to build primarily the infrastructure and compute platform that all of the researchers at OpenAI use for their work. You do not need to be an ML/DL expert to deliver world-class infrastructure, but you do need to be able to quickly obtain a deep technical understanding of new domains. You should enjoy being self-directed and identifying the most important problems to solve as the team matures with standardized tools and processes around stability, observability, and scaling. As a Software Engineer focused on infrastructure with the Supercomputing team, you should: Know your way around bash, Terraform, Python, and/or Chef Have experience designing large, highly available distributed systems with Kubernetes or Mesos clusters in the range of 500+ nodes. text: Job Application for Technical Program Manager, Security at OpenAI Apply Now Technical Program Manager, Security at OpenAI (View all jobs) San Francisco, California, United States OpenAI is pushing artificial intelligence to unprecedented scale. We have a large cloud footprint and run some of the biggest Kubernetes clusters in the world. As our scale has grown, so has the surface area we need to protect. While advanced AI can benefit the world, in the wrong hands, it can also be used maliciously. Your job will be to protect our work from those who seek to misuse it. As a Technical Program Manager on the Security team, you will help scale the security and IT programs at OpenAI. We’re looking for a candidate who thrives cross-functionally, can handle complexity, and who is motivated to help a small team be greater than the sum of its parts. You will: Manage and scale large security and IT programs across OpenAI while working closely with partners in research and engineering. Work with security engineers and our partners to capture requirements and ensure execution on security initiatives. Coordinate our privacy and compliance programs for OpenAI's product, sales, and research initiatives. Drive operational maturity by implementing processes and metrics where they can provide the most value. Help plan OpenAI Security's strategic impact by contributing to quarterly and long-term planning. title: Software Engineer, Model Evaluation
text: Job Application for Software Engineer, Model Evaluation at OpenAI Apply Now Software Engineer, Model Evaluation at OpenAI (View all jobs) San Francisco, California, United States About the Team: OpenAI puts particular emphasis on large-scale deep learning. Our approach results in a small number of extremely capable models. Towards that end, we need to make a lot of difficult decisions based on incomplete data. The Science of Deep Learning team tries to fundamentally understand what is happening as our models scale and how to evaluate their performance. About the Role: Evaluation metrics allow us to understand what is happening under-the-hood and the progress of our models. We are looking for an engineer who wants to create the requisite systems/frameworks for making sense of these evaluations. As a software engineer on the team, you will be responsible for: Creating the API specific to evaluations that will stand the test of time Designing the tooling and frameworks needed for cataloging all present/future evaluations Designing tooling for evaluation visualizations and analysis OpenAI is a very small team. You will work directly with our best researchers and engineers to help make key decisions pushing our state of the art models towards previously unexplored regimes of AI capabilities. You’ll closely collaborate with the Science of Deep Learning team to refine our evaluation tools and methodology. This is a 0-1 effort and a huge area of investment for us. The ability to understand/analyze evals systematically will allow us to answer questions like, "How close are our models to AGI?" About yourself : Good taste in API design, thinking through long-term success vs short-term happiness Excited by building tooling that accelerates the efficiency of our technical teams. Track record of excellent engineering skills across multiple domains Interested in understanding what happens under-the-hood of AI models Open to technical leadership down the road Bonus Points if You : Have experience in statistical analysis, to draw correct conclusions from the sea of data we swim in Have experience in database design Have data visualization experience About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. title: Research Engineer, Code Generation
text: Job Application for Research Engineer, Code Generation at OpenAI Apply Now Research Engineer, Code Generation at OpenAI (View all jobs) San Francisco, CA Our mission at OpenAI is to discover and enact the path to safe, beneficial AGI. To do this, we believe that many technical breakthroughs are needed in generative modeling, reinforcement learning, large scale optimization, active learning, among other topics. The Code Generation team at OpenAI researches and develops AI programmers - neural models that write, debug and improve computer programs. Creating AI which can solve hard symbolic reasoning problems is one of the most difficult problems in modern deep learning and we’re attacking it head-on. We seek new ways for increasingly powerful AI systems to interact with the world through a very general interface of computer code. Our first release, Codex , demonstrates the power of neural program synthesis through a family of large generative models that power GitHub Copilot . We’re excited to explore creative new interactions which will reshape the way the industry thinks about coding. On the Code Generation team, you’ll work at the very center of OpenAI’s mission to create artificial general intelligent AI systems that benefit all of humanity. In our day-to-day work, we build on top of all the achievements of OpenAI to date, by training some of the largest models ever trained, studying scaling laws, running distributed reinforcement learning, and aligning our most capable models. We seek a talented Research Engineer to us deliver the next breakthrough. In this role, you will: Write clean and performant code to train ML models, focusing on throughput, stability, and ML metrics Build interfaces for humans to interact with new generations of code-generating models Debug complex distributed systems Clean and analyze large datasets Implement sandboxing techniques for safe code execution This might be a good match if you: Have strong programming and problem-solving skills, with a 3+ year track record of relevant engineering experience Are a team player: we believe in working collectively towards a common goal. Value impact over novelty: a surprising number of very hard problems can be solved with a careful application of existing techniques. Aren’t afraid of grunt work: we often see that the most dramatic results are achieved with hard, unglamorous work Nice to have: Past experience with large distributed machine learning projects Experience managing annotations by human contractors About OpenAI We’re building safe Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), and ensuring it leads to a good outcome for humans. text: Job Application for Senior AI Strategist at OpenAI Apply Now Senior AI Strategist at OpenAI (View all jobs) San Francisco, California, United States The Financial Times wrote that "OpenAI ranks as one of the most unusual organizations on the planet." We're one of the leaders in AI research and deployment, and we're working to build safe Artificial General Intelligence (AGI). We believe AGI has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges such as climate change, affordable healthcare, and personalized education, and we want the economic upside of AGI to be widely shared. About our product We're building the definitive platform for AI technology, making it easier for developers to benefit from AI via a simple HTTPS call. We accomplished this by launching the OpenAI API to the public in 2021. We think the best way to see the potential and magic of our product is to try it yourself. You can create a free account and try our API here . GPT-3 was the first AI technology available via the API, allowing developers to integrate any language task into their product. The MIT Technology Review listed GPT-3 as one of the 10 Breakthrough Technologies of 2021 (alongside other innovations like mRNA vaccines). Recently, we introduced Codex into our API, a new product that translates natural language to code. Instagram's co-founder called Github Copilot (an early product powered by Codex) "the single most mind-blowing application of ML I've ever seen." About the role Our Go-to-Market team is responsible for empowering developers and enterprises to build and scale production applications with the OpenAI API, guiding and supporting customers to attain maximum benefits from deploying our highly-capable models. This role serves as a technically savvy account manager that will help customers understand and implement highly-capable machine learning models using our API. We see this as a path towards safe and broadly beneficial AGI by gaining practical experience in deploying these technologies safely and easily by developers and customers. Within the Applied AI group, the Trust and Safety team protects OpenAI’s technologies from abuse. We develop tools and processes to detect, understand, and mitigate large-scale misuse. We’re a small, focused team that cares deeply about safely enabling users to build useful things with our products. In 2020, we introduced GPT-3 as the first technology on the OpenAI API, allowing developers to integrate its ability to understand and generate natural language into their product. OpenAI Legal plays an indispensable role in achieving OpenAI's mission by navigating cutting edge legal issues in the field of AI. If you care deeply about doing meaningful and novel work as a technology lawyer, this is the place for you. Our Applied AI team is responsible for the safe development and commercialization of OpenAI's innovations, principally our OpenAI API. The Associate General Counsel, Applied AI, will own and lead all legal initiatives for this team. This role will report to the General Counsel, and frequently engage with senior leadership. Your responsibilities will include: Lead the legal function for the Applied AI team, with a focus on operationalizing and scaling legal support for product development, partnership and commercialization efforts, crafting all associated legal strategies and processes and overseeing all related agreements. Build an elite and lean legal team for Applied AI by recruiting top in-house talent and managing external counsel for effective and efficient results. Advise the leadership team on Applied AI matters, with the objective of ensuring that any commercial successes continue to advance our core mission. Partner closely with the technical and product teams to proactively manage risks, identify legal issues and shape key decisions. What we are looking for: The basics: JD from an accredited law school, license in good standing with the California Bar, 10+ years of legal experience and prior in-house experience at a reputable technology company. The specifics: Deep proficiency in licensing, IP and product counseling issues, a solid understanding of data privacy and security, regulatory compliance requirements and public policy considerations, and a track record of delivering measurable results. The standout: Prior in-depth experience in AI/ML legal issues, a technical background or other unusual attributes would be great to see! You might enjoy this role if you are: An owner. text: Job Application for Senior Manager, Revenue Operations at OpenAI Apply Now Senior Manager, Revenue Operations at OpenAI (View all jobs) San Francisco, California, United States About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core. OpenAI is dedicated to putting that alignment of interests first — ahead of profit. To achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. Our investment in diversity, equity, and inclusion is ongoing, executed through a wide range of initiatives, and championed and supported by leadership. At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology. The Financial Times wrote that “OpenAI ranks as one of the most unusual organizations on the planet”. We’re one of the leaders in AI development and we’re working to build safe Artificial General Intelligence (AGI). We believe AGI has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges such as climate change, affordable healthcare, and personalized education, and we want the economic upside of AGI to be widely shared. About the product We’re building the definitive platform for AI technology, making it easier for developers to benefit from AI. Last year we introduced the OpenAI API which makes leading AI technology available to developers via a simple HTTPS call. GPT3 was the first AI technology available via the API, allowing developers to integrate any language task into their product. The MIT Technology Review listed GPT3 as one of the 10 Breakthrough Technologies of 2021 (alongside mRNA vaccines!). Recently, we introduced Codex into the API, a new product that translates natural language to code. Instragram’s co-founder called Github Copilot , an early product powered by Codex, “the single most mind-blowing application of ML I’ve ever seen”. We’re working to bring other research efforts into the API, such as Dall-E, AI which generates images from text and CLIP, a state-of-the-art image classification AI . About the role This is an exciting time at OpenAI! In the last three months, we launched two groundbreaking products Codex and Copilot , and established our go-to-market team to ramp up our commercialization efforts. As the first member in our Revenue Operations team, you'll: Own and execute the Applied AI GTM in partnership with API Leadership team and Head of GTM Be a thought partner across GTM leadership on short and long-range (multi-year) strategies, including operating priorities, org design, market analysis, and select priority performance improvement programs Serve as the Head of GTM strategic advisor; p rovide analysis and advice on pricing for new products and segments With Strategic Finance, own GTM forecasting / target setting, and general insight generation (e.g., pipeline analysis, research) Build the RevOps function for our Customer Success and BD teams from the ground up Closely monitor the industry landscape (people, competitors, partners, etc.) to contribute to the GTM strategy and playbook: hiring plan, territory management, marketing budget, sales enablement, T&E budgeting, etc. By being curious, determined, and kind you’ll help our exceptional customers radically improve their businesses, and change the world in the process. title: Offensive Security Engineer, Preparedness
text: Job Application for Offensive Security Engineer, Preparedness at OpenAI Apply Now Offensive Security Engineer, Preparedness at OpenAI (View all jobs) San Francisco, California, United States About the team Frontier AI models have the potential to benefit all of humanity but also pose increasingly severe risks. To ensure that AI promotes positive change, we have dedicated a team to help us best prepare for the development of increasingly capable frontier AI models. This team, Preparedness, reports directly to our CTO and is tasked with identifying, tracking, and preparing for catastrophic risks related to frontier AI models. Specifically, the mission of the Preparedness team is to: Closely monitor and predict the evolving capabilities of frontier AI systems, with an eye towards misuse risks whose impact could be catastrophic (not necessarily existential) to our society and ensure we have concrete procedures, infrastructure, and partnerships to mitigate these risks and, more broadly, to handle the development of powerful AI systems safely. Our team will tightly connect capability assessment, evaluations, internal red teaming for frontier models, and overall coordination on AGI preparedness. The team’s core goal is to ensure that we have the infrastructure needed for the safety of highly capable AI systems—from the models we develop in the near future to those with AGI-level capabilities. About the role: We are looking to hire an exceptional offensive security engineer to push the boundaries of our frontier models. We are looking for those with an expert grasp of offensive security, AI safety concerns, and how our frontier models will shape offensive security capabilities. In this role, you will: Work on identifying offensive security capabilities present in frontier models, and how they might assist with adversarial cybersecurity operations. Assist in building and refining evaluations of frontier AI models that assess the extent of these identified risks. Build scalable systems and processes to support these evaluations. Contribute to the refinement of risk management and the overall development of "best practice" guidelines for AI safety evaluations You might thrive in this role if you are: Passionate and knowledgeable about short-term and long-term AI safety risks. title: Senior Manager of Procure to Pay Operations
text: Job Application for Senior Manager of Procure to Pay Operations at OpenAI Apply Now Senior Manager of Procure to Pay Operations at OpenAI (View all jobs) San Francisco, California, United States About the Role We’re looking for a seasoned Procure to Pay Operations Manager who will lead our procure to pay processes and systems. This role requires a blend of procurement request management, systems management, and accounts payable management, with additional oversight on our travel and expense process. This role requires someone who can build, scale, and adapt our processes to support our organizations rapid growth. This strategic, yet hands-on role, will report to the Head of Procurement, interfacing closely with suppliers, internal stakeholders, and leading external contractors executing our processes. You will be instrumental in enhancing the financial workflow of the organization by refining and sustaining a streamlined Procure to Pay operations process. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: Devise and implement a holistic strategy for our P2P operations, aligning with OpenAI’s broader financial and operational objectives. Take ownership of the month-end close process for Purchase Order accruals and Accounts Payable reporting and reconciliations, ensuring accuracy and timeliness in financial reporting. Support the audit process by taking ownership of Procure to Pay cycle requests, ensuring thorough and timely responses to audit inquiries and maintaining organized documentation for audit trails. Manage and optimize our P2P systems - ZIP, NetSuite, and Navan (for T&E), ensuring seamless procurement and financial operations. Take a hands-on role in managing outsourced AP contractors, including overseeing coding review and processing payment batches, to ensure accuracy and compliance in line with OpenAI’s financial policies and procedures. Oversee the travel and expense program, promoting compliance with our financial policies while ensuring timely and accurate processing and reconciliation. Aim to maximize the value from our T&E budget and provide the best traveler experience. Engage with internal customers across various departments, understanding their procurement needs, and ensuring a streamlined procurement request and approval process. Work closely with Legal and Security to ensure that vendor reviews are complete and timely. Ensure we meet processing SLAs such as: request cycle time, percentage of invoices under PO, and percentage of digital invoices. Lead reporting and analytics initiatives within the P2P domain, generating insightful reports and dashboards to monitor performance, identify trends, and support data-driven decision-making aligned with OpenAI's financial and operational goals. Manage the performance of external contractors who fulfill and execute processes within the procure to pay cycle, ensuring adherence to defined standards and continuous performance improvement. We’re looking for a blend of: Bachelor's degree with 10+ years of progressive experience in procurement and accounts payable, preferably within technology-centric organizations or late-stage startups. Solid understanding of Procure to Pay (P2P) processes, systems, and best practices. Strong project management skills, encompassing attention to detail and ability to prioritize and lead high priority initiatives on concurrent timelines. Exemplary interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, as demonstrated by the ability to interact effectively with both internal teams and external partners. Experience working with modern P2P software and systems, particularly ZIP, NetSuite, and Navan. Strong analytical skills, including a propensity for data-driven decision-making and experience with reporting and analytics tools to monitor P2P performance metrics. Proven experience in managing Travel & Expense (T&E) processes, with a focus on policy compliance, process efficiency, and maximizing value from the T&E budget while ensuring a positive experience for travelers. You might thrive in this role if: You’re an enthusiastic self-starter. You thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment, and expect to lead multiple projects. You take ownership of your work and believe that a job not done well is a job not done. You’re excited about new challenges. You don’t have the answers to every question up front, but the process of solving them invigorates you. Novel issues requiring multidimensional knowledge excite you. You’re a phenomenal teammate. You’re a strong communicator who can explain complex topics with ease, in any format. You intuitively understand the importance of keeping everyone in the loop, and you take proactive measures to do so. You’re intellectually honest. You’re a world-class leader. You mentor those around you, help set agendas, and unblock company-wide issues. You identify opportunities for cross-functional projects and emphatically step in to lead them. Your commitment to quality is unwavering and you coach the work of those around you to join you at this elevated level. You’re a builder. You not only embrace the opportunity to have a direct impact on how a company operates, you revel in it. An organization relies on the quality of its foundation and your passion is building strong systems and processes from the ground up. You’re passionate about technology and artificial intelligence. We believe that achieving our goal requires effective engagement with public policy stakeholders and the broader community impacted by AI worldwide. Accordingly, our Global Affairs team builds authentic, collaborative relationships with public officials and the broader AI policy community to inform and support our shared work in these domains. We ensure that insights from policymakers, practitioners and experts inform our work and - in collaboration with our colleagues and external stakeholders - seek to further regulation, industry standards, and safe and beneficial development of AI tools. About the Role As International Policy Analyst on the Global Affairs team, you will support the Head of International Policy and Partnerships in developing strategies for engagement with policymakers, industry colleagues, researchers and the wider stakeholder community outside the United States and Europe. You will be critical to supporting effective collaboration among colleagues representing OpenAI across multiple world regions and countries, and will support OpenAI leadership in meetings, briefings, hearings and other engagements for high priority international policy issues. In this role, you will have the unique opportunity to help ensure that the most advanced generative AI technologies are developed and deployed in ways that benefit humanity as a whole, especially in regions insufficiently prioritized by previous global technological and economic advances. OpenAI releases industry-leading research and tools. You will face new challenges as the impact of cutting edge generative AI technologies continues to be explored and as the needs of the organization evolve, and as emerging policy debates create new opportunities for engagement with policymakers and communities worldwide. We seek an individual with a sophisticated understanding of AI-related regulatory issues and processes across a diverse array of global political systems and societies.
